question: Find the full name of the youngest German driver born between 1980 and 1985 who participated in the race with ID 348, and compute their average fastest lap time (in seconds) across all races they've entered.

    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id, d.XCL_038 AS forename, d.XCL_039 AS surname

      AND d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT XCL_075 FROM results WHERE XCL_074 = 348)
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

        (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) +

    td.forename,
    td.surname,
    AVG(fl.time_in_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM target_driver td
JOIN fastest_laps fl ON td.driver_id = fl.driver_id

        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') - 1) AS REAL) +
            CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0) AS min_lap_seconds
    FROM lapTimes lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
      AND lt.XCL_047 != ''
    GROUP BY lt.XCL_044
)
SELECT
    td.full_name,
    AVG(fl.min_lap_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM target_driver td
JOIN fastest_laps fl ON td.driver_id = fl.driver_id

WITH target_driver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id, d.XCL_038 AS forename, d.XCL_039 AS surname
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND d.XCL_040 BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
      AND d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT XCL_075 FROM results WHERE XCL_074 = 348)
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) +
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') - INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) +
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL AND r.XCL_088 != ''
)
SELECT
    td.forename,
    td.surname,
    AVG(fl.time_in_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM target_driver td
JOIN fastest_laps fl ON td.driver_id = fl.driver_id
